description: Frozen public licensed fixture corpus for Snag & Brag; never contains player photos. Labels are human visual judgments assigned before scoring. Source thumbnails are center-cropped with the game capture; originals are not retained. Object and face fixtures are isolated. Only the source licenses apply to JPEG assets, independently of the repository MIT code license. Face boxes are coarse axis-aligned visible-face annotations at 720 px, excluding hair and neck, reviewed against full-resolution input fixtures. They are not detector outputs or identification labels.
